skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the nature of environmental planning, its role in development planning, and the role of environmental planning in resource management.
Apply the process and methods of environmental planning, evaluate options, and select optimal solutions for environmental planning.
Develop independent working skills, self-study, and creativity.
Possess the ability to work in a team, be autonomous, and take responsibility.
Use GIS for environmental planning and mapping.
Conduct environmental impact assessments and use multi-criteria evaluation methods.
Analyze policies and regulations related to environmental planning.
Manage natural resources and environmental protection.
Plan urban and industrial areas considering environmental factors.
Develop strategic plans for environmental sustainability.
